bull_bear.body:
- Stock split + bonus done to boost liquidity / shareholder count (~11,000 → ~25,000; target 100k-150k).
- No equity dilution intended for capex; promoter willing to infuse unsecured loans; rights issue preferred over preferential/private placement if needed.
- Acquisition appetite continues (FDF/peptide) but discretionary.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body:
- **Working capital:** receivables ~200+ days (mgmt benchmark ~180 for API; admits ~130-140 average); ~INR 100 cr receivables ≈ 60% of sales; consol operating cash flow -INR 47 cr. New strict 120-day stop-supply policy; positive CF promised by FY27-end — KEY proof point.
- **Legacy bad-ish receivable:** lost a distributor (~INR 20-30 cr stuck flagged Nov-2025); INR 11 cr recovered, ~INR 17 cr outstanding — "not defaulted."
- **Raw-material volatility:** >100% input inflation; ability to fully reprice is the swing factor on margin.
- **Margin guidance wobble:** MD gave 30-35%, then 25-30%, then "~25% conservative" within one call — model on lower end.
- **Acquisition integration:** three acquisitions in ~12 months; consolidation of Apiqo/Bizotic minority (share swap) pending AGM.
- **Credit rating flag:** CARE marked "issuer not cooperating" (historical dispute since 2018-19, MD disputes CARE's conduct); Brickwork withdrew BB-; fresh Brickwork rating expected ~BBB- within 45 days — verify.
- **Execution dependence:** FY28 700-800 cr target needs new facility on time + working-capital funding + DMF commercializations.
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: - Single-voice call (MD only); candid and granular on numbers, receivables, the CARE dispute, and Q4 margin causes. Some hesitancy/inconsistency on EBITDA guidance and a deferred tax-rate question (to be answered offline). Confident, slightly promotional on the FY28 doubling and acquisition cadence; anchors guidance to existing customer projections. Audio issues truncated several questions (Remember Pharma answer promised offline).
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body:
- Real story is a roll-up: NSAID API specialist → backward-integrated (Bizotic/Apiqo intermediates) → forward into FDF/formulations (Remember Pharma) + CDMO + specialty chemicals — building a vertically-integrated platform, not just an API maker.
- Q4 PAT drop is largely transient cost-pass-through lag, not demand — pharma demand "increased vs pre-war"; the durable question is working capital, not the P&L.
- The genuine moat is process chemistry (methylation, Friedel-Crafts) on niche NSAIDs with only 2-3 Indian / 5-6 global players — pricing/cost edge + innovator + top-generic customers + 21 DMFs.
- A listed large pharma customer is reportedly delaying payments despite Anlon's MSME 45-day status; Anlon leverages being on the customer's DMF (hard to switch) to enforce terms — shows niche supplier stickiness.
- Microcap with stretched cash conversion entering a leveraged capex + acquisition phase — execution and WC discipline (not order book) are the binding constraints.
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Inorganic growth funded through cash acquisitions (₹3.79 crore for Bizotic, ₹5.40 crore for Apiqo), with a focus on strategic fit and scalability.
- Net debt/equity improved from 3.55x in FY24 to 0.17x in FY26, reflecting strengthened balance sheet post-equity raise (net worth ₹254.79 crore in FY26).

deepdive.thesis: Anlon delivered a strong FY26 (total income +43% to INR 172 cr, EBITDA +48% to INR 47.8 cr, PAT +42% to INR 29.1 cr) and bolted on three acquisitions (Apiqo, Bizotic, and FY27's Remember Pharma) to build a backward-integrated NSAID-API + intermediates + CDMO + formulations platform — but Q4 PAT fell YoY (INR 11.1 cr vs INR 16.7 cr) as a raw-material/solvent cost spike ("war situation", prices >2x) hit B2B contracts already priced at old rates, compressing margins. The story now hinges on (a) repricing customers and restoring the ~25-30% EBITDA band, (b) ramping consolidated capacity (1,400-1,600 MTPA) plus a new INR 130 cr Rajkot greenfield (commissioning ~Q1 FY28) toward a 30% revenue CAGR (FY27 ~INR 380-400 cr, FY28 ~INR 700-800 cr), and (c) fixing a stretched working-capital cycle (receivables ~200+ days, consolidated cash flow at -INR 47 cr).
